title: Wayfinder gatefold: entry visuals and microframe screenshot system for Quickstart landing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design compact entry experience for the Quickstart landing that scales from tiny mobile headers to large marketing hero banners. Deliver a modular "wayfinder" gatefold system: a core hero illustration (static + light motion), three progressive step diagrams (microframes), and a screenshot placeholder system that integrates with engineering's responsive screenshot pipeline. Goal: reduce cognitive load on first visit, make next steps actionable, and provide front-end-ready assets and tokens for release.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file includes: hero composition (desktop/tablet/mobile), three microframe step diagrams, and componentized screenshot placeholders (single source of truth)
Exported assets: SVGs for all static illustrations, Lottie export for hero micro-animation (looping, <150kb), PNG/2x for annotated screenshots, and CSS-ready spacing tokens
Accessibility: color palette passes contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for UI elements; all imagery has descriptive alt copy in the spec
Engineering handoff: README with breakpoints, image size recommendations, and import map for placeholder images; sample HTML snippet for hero and microframe with progressive enhancement
Design review sign-off from PM (Tomás Rivera) and Eng lead (Liam O'Connor) recorded in comments
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya Chen: Kickoff — scoped hero + microframe system. Decided to prioritize a single flexible illustration that can be cropped rather than three unique illustrations to reduce engineering asset weight.
